description: Remove the preview link of an R3 project: every preview link to it stops working at once (teammates' too). Only when the user asked for it, or on your own when the preview link is what blocks an r3_project_delete you were asked to do: a preview link is temporary, so you may remove it then, and you must tell the user you did. A live project stays live; a project that was only previewed is no longer published. Deletes nothing: r3_preview_create makes a new link. A project with no open preview link is refused and left as it is. Needs the publish:preview right.
name: r3_preview_remove

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Remove a preview link
